answer: Behavioral Basis Fingerprinting. Each identity's outputs are mapped to a low-dimensional basis of semantic habits; sybils cloned from one operator share basis vectors, so a cluster is flagged when its members' basis coherence exceeds chance. Enforcement: flagged clusters enter a vault quarantine, freeze payouts, and require independent re-derivation. A raven marker — a signed provenance plume attached to each contribution — lets auditors trace which seed produced the cluster, raising per-identity cost by forcing distinct behavioral seeds.
